title: Gandalf and the First Tree
story: Gandalf awoke on a beach of cubic sand, smelling the strange sea of a blocky realm. Approaching an oak tree, he raised his staff, expecting thunder, but only heard the hollow thud of wood. 'Curious,' the wizard murmured, rolling up his gray sleeves and punching the trunk with bare knuckles until wood floated gently into his palm. 'Even in Valinor, we never gathered lumber with such directness.'

title: The Fellowship in the Nether
story: The Fellowship stood upon crimson nylium beside an ocean of boiling lava. 'This reminds me of the Black Gate of Mordor,' grunted Gimli, gripping his iron battleaxe. 'Aye,' whispered Legolas, notching an arrow into his bow, 'except the clouds here are crying ghosts that spit explosive fireballs. Keep your heads down, friends!'

title: The Discovery of Redstone
story: Deep within the granite shafts beneath the Shire, Gandalf stumbled upon a vein of crimson dust glowing in the dark. He touched it with his staff, and a nearby iron door snapped open with a resounding clatter. 'Saruman spoke of gears and gunpowder,' whispered Gandalf, eyes widening, 'yet here lies pure logic woven into dust. We could automate the harvesting of Old Toby!'

title: The Warden of Khazad-dûm
story: Delving beneath Y: -50, the company fell silent. Sculk tendrils crept across the slate, and an eerie heartbeat echoed through the ancient ruins. 'What is that?' whispered Pippin, accidentally triggering a sculk shrieker. Gandalf froze, raising his hand. 'A creature from the ancient world. It cannot see you, but it hears every step. Walk like the dew upon the grass, or prepare to meet the abyss.'

title: Flight on Dragonback
story: Standing atop the obsidian pillars of the End dimension, Gandalf looked into the purple void. 'They asked how we could take the Ring to Mount Doom,' he chuckled, polishing his newly forged Elytra wings. 'If only Lord Elrond had thought to defeat an Ender Dragon and craft a stack of rocket fireworks first!'
